turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on he, she and it with -s?
turns.tutor:
Hello! Sure. In the present simple, after he, she and it we add -s to the verb: I work - she works. After -sh, -ch, -s, -x or -o, add -es: teach - teaches. Consonant + y becomes -ies: study - studies.

Exercise: Write the correct form:
My sister ___ (play) tennis on Sundays.

Answer with only the verb.
